name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.app.MainActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT main Activity opens for the SDK's main, Android VIEW, or SEARCH action. It routes text and image searches and supplied search results, and hosts the search home, news, history, and linked web pages.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot open the iQNECT search experience, history, news, or linked pages through this Activity.
